course.title: Foundation Engineering
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A structure is supported on six columns arranged as shown in the figure given below. All columns are 20 inch x 20 inch in size. The central columns carry a load 275 kips each. The load on each of the end columns is 175 kips. Design the suitable raft foundation (slab-beam type). The allowable bearing capacity of the soil is 2.0 ksf. Use $\mathrm { ~ \textit ~ { ~ f ~ } ~ } _ { \mathrm { c } } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $\mathfrak { f } _ { \mathfrak { s } } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement detaits.
